structure: Part 7 mined all 7 traces of four consignment-parties.fit.spec.js describes, each opened and its full action list read, with snapshots, evals and network logs taken on every page in scope. Trace names used in refs: [A] consignment-parties--add-an-address-from-the-journey-place-of-origin-an-international-address-entered-by-hand.zip (place of origin add-address, manual international entry, empty-submit errors, save and return to the picker); [B] consignment-parties--add-an-address-from-the-journey-consignee-a-uk-address-found-by-search-then-completed.zip (consignee add-address, UK lookup, empty-submit errors on the hidden fields, search 'Acorn', pick, complete contact details, save and select back to the roles page); [C] consignment-parties--add-address-pages-for-the-other-roles-consignor-is-entered-by-hand-importer-and-place-of-destination-search-uk-addresses.zip (consignor, importer and place of destination add-address pages opened from each picker's 'Add a new address' link, not submitted); [D] consignment-parties--contact-address-for-consignment-choose-the-contact-address.zip (contact address page, empty-submit error, choose an address, continue to review-notification); [E] consignment-parties--contact-address-for-consignment-add-a-new-branch-address-from-the-contact-page.zip (the 'add a new branch address' link to the address-book Add address details lookup page, not submitted); [F] consignment-parties--permanent-address-cat-one-choice-per-animal-same-as-destination-or-a-new-address.zip (2 cats; the per-animal Permanent address page, 'Add a place of destination before you can continue' error, new-address reveal and per-animal field errors, then a place of destination chosen and both animals set to same as POD, back to the roles page); [G] consignment-parties--permanent-address-the-enter-address-path-is-retired-and-lands-on-the-per-animal-page.zip (GET /permanent-address/enter-address redirects to /permanent-address/select). Each trace first walks the shared set-up (create notification, live animals, France, a commodity, Internal market / Breeding, a number of animals) to /roles-and-addresses; that set-up belongs to earlier parts and is not claimed here. Pages in this part, in journey position: (1) the add-address page 'Add address and contact details' at /<role>/add-address, reached from each role picker's 'Add a new address' link; it has two variants - manual international entry for place of origin and consignor (fields always shown, country select of 42 countries), and UK lookup for consignee, importer and place of destination (a 'Search for an address' box, address fields hidden until a result is picked, country fixed to United Kingdom); each variant shows a 'What else should this address be used for?' checkbox list of the role's sibling roles; (2) the place of origin picker as it renders after 'Save and return to address page' (success banner, new address in the list); (3) the roles page as it renders after 'Save and select' (success banner, the new address filled in for the role); (4) Contact address for consignment at /contact-address-for-consignment, radios of three addresses, error state, continue to /review-notification; (5) Add address details at /address-book/add/lookup (address book branch-address lookup, conditional on the contact page link); (6) Permanent address at /permanent-address/select, one card per animal (cat only), conditional reveal of a new-address form, two error states; (7) the roles page Permanent address row after saving. /permanent-address and /permanent-address/enter-address both redirect to /permanent-address/select. Address search made no network call. The role pickers themselves are part 6's and are claimed here only as the entry point. Surfaces the traces never reached are recorded as gaps.

claims.statement: The traces never save a permanent address entered by hand, never give the two animals different addresses, and never exercise 'Save and return to hub', so how different per-animal addresses display on the Consignment addresses page and the review is not shown.
Only cats are exercised on the Permanent address page; which other species need a permanent address (and so see this row instead of, or as well as, CPH) is not shown.

Saved addresses, contact address and permanent address choices are held only in the prototype's server session (form posts with 302 redirects); no call to an address-book or notification API appears in any of the seven traces.
